lines.t: the shadows flee the veil is gone eternity light on ending fills the air
every tear is washed away every night is turned today heaven's breath forever here
whispers peace your home my child no more pain no more fight only love only light
the lamb who reigns upon the throne calls his children to his home
You are the light of the eternal morning
In your love we are your masterpiece
The river of love, your master trees
The sound of peace in endless dreams
The voice that called from worlds unknown
Now lives within the heart's history
Time has bowed the circle complete
Forever starts and ends in you
The king and bride in peace
of the eternal morning every heart forever free every soul in unity glory rising never fades
love eternal never sways endless dawn no more sorrow eternal morning no tomorrow
The light remains, the songs still ring
The bride rests near the feet of the King
The sky forever in heavenly glow
